The '''Coruscanti Compact Cruiser''' was a type of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscanti Compact Cruiser was introduced to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in Game Update 7.6.1 to the massively multiplayer online roleplaying game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It is inspired by the [[JPP-192 limospeeder]],<ref name="TOR" /> which appeared in the [[Canon]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''.<ref name="Andor">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}</ref>
